notes: This catalog reads MPQ tables and internal (listfile) metadata; it does not extract game-file payloads or modify source archives.
Only filenames exposed by an archive's usable internal (listfile) can be compared as real paths. Unnamed table entries are counted as anonymous.
Archive layer categories are descriptive. No effective client load order or winning archive is inferred.
Duplicate paths are grouped case-insensitively after normalizing slash direction.
Each file provider is [archiveIndex, uncompressedSizeBytes, compressedSizeBytes, flags]; archiveIndex refers to the same position in the archives array.
File paths preserve the first listed spelling; extension and name-source metadata are omitted because they can be derived from the path and the anonymous path prefix.
